hook: Pick who you play last, then watch your court strike out of turn in a rising storm of Gusts.
loop: Choose your Announced unit by what you play last, and seat everyone.
Gusts stack up: extra attacks out of turn, in reading order.
Gusts pump the Announced carry, leave permanent stats, or fire the Thunderhead.

growth.line: Small permanent gains early; from Tier 4 Gusts multiply, and the Tier 6 Warden floods the Announced unit.

feel.early: Small bodies sneaking a free hit before the fight.
feel.mid: Seating puzzle: who's Announced, who Gusts first.
feel.late: Fifteen-plus Gusts a fight and a Thunderhead finish.

stars.why: Saves up Thunder, then unleashes up to ten Gusts; seat him carefully.
Always Announced too, so two carries and every Announced payoff doubles.
Forces the enemy's biggest units to Gust into his thorns.

card_short.u01: Gusts at Start of Combat if nobody has Gusted yet.
card_short.u02: Takes no damage while Gusting; grows permanently after Gusting.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: your Announced unit permanently gains stats.
card_short.u04: Start of Combat: Announced unit next to this Gusts.
card_short.u05: Flips each turn: Fair pays gold, Foul makes Announced Gust.
card_short.u06: Start of Combat: Gusts, and its Gusts hit beside too.
card_short.u07: After enemy attacks, Gusts at their weakest unit, any row.
card_short.u08: Units that Gust permanently gain +1/+1, three times a fight.
card_short.u09: Gold for last fight's Gusts; else grows your Announced unit.
card_short.u10: Always Announced too; Announced units Gust at Start of Combat.
card_short.u11: A Gust that kills lets that unit Gust again.
card_short.u12: Bristle, Hunker; enemy's three biggest Gust into him first.
card_short.u13: When played: get a Bag of Winds.
card_short.u14: Copies the tribe and text of your last-played unit.
card_short.u15: Units after this in reading order Gust, until a non-Gale.
card_short.u16: Gusting units take no damage; Gust kills give permanent stats.
card_short.u17: Attacks last; banks Thunder per Gust, then Gusts per Thunder.
card_short.u18: Shuts off enemy Start of Combat; Announced steals 3 attacks.
card_short.u19: Every friendly Gust gives Announced units permanent +2/+2, ten times.
card_short.x01: Item: permanent +2/+2 and a Start of Combat Gust.
card_short.x02: Ruling: how Sir Vane's copying works with Helm and tribes.
card_short.x03: Ruling: Föhn's forced Gusts trigger your cards, never the enemy's.
card_short.x04: Ruling: two High Pressures stop all Start of Combat.

builds.name: Storm front
builds.line: Crier chains Gusts down the line; the Thunderhead cashes them in.

builds.name: The Announced court
builds.line: Any tribe's best unit, played last, soaks Red Sky and Warden buffs.

builds.name: Ill wind
builds.line: Föhn and the Windhover punish big attackers before the fight starts.

liked: Choosing what to play last and where to seat it is a real puzzle.
Thunderhead's seating puzzle and Föhn turning enemy attacks into your engine stood out.
worries: Watch: Sir Vane copying capstones, and Warden with Helm, can run away late.
Watch: Lady High Pressure near-locks Start of Combat boards; Wild Hunt stacks free value.
changed: Gust is now an attack but not a normal attack, settling what reacts.
Old Föhn gains Hunker; his forced Gusts no longer feed enemy cards.
Fair-and-Foul and the Barometer Clerk now feed the Announced unit.
verdict: Play-order puzzle fans get a storm to steer, choosing who comes last and where each courtier sits.
